name: Hunan Gold Corporation Limited
summary: Hunan Gold Corporation Limited engages in the exploration, mining, and beneficiation of gold, antimony, and tungsten in China. The company offers gold ingots, refined antimony, antimony oxide, antimony glycol, and flame-retardant masterbatch for plastics; gold concentrate, antimony concentrate, and tungsten concentrate; and management and technical consulting services. It is also involved in smelting and processing of gold, antimony, and other non-ferrous metals; engineering surveying, topographic control, and mine surveying; import and export of commodities and technologies; and investment in mining enterprises, high-tech projects, and enterprises.
